Character performance and resident anatomy

Juliette, Sims and Bernard now use the same resident anatomy as the ensemble.
The former imported avatars are excluded from the deployed game; historical
regression fixtures retain their original provenance in the source repository.

Resident anatomy: derived from the MakeHuman base mesh, default rig and weights.
CC0, Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius and Jonas Hauquier, 2020–2021.
https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/tree/master/makehuman/data

resident-faces.jpg: cropped and packed CC0 face textures by Toigo,
OnlyTheGhosts, Mindfront, Jartur69 and Cutoff3D from MakeHuman's CC0 skin packs.
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins01.html
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins02.html

Runtime gait measurements: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database,
funded by NSF EIA-0196217. Recordings 07_01, 07_03, 07_04 and 35_17.
https://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/
BVH conversion by Bruce Hahne / cgspeed; no additional use restrictions.

Reproduction instructions, selected sources, modifications and validation:
docs/character-performance.md in the source repository.
